finalMessage:
Porto Notes is implemented and `./verify.sh` passes all 7 gates. ## What I built | File | Role | |---|---| | `index.html` | Static shell: form, search panel, `#feed`. Labelled fields, `h1→h2→h3` heading order. | | `src/richtext.ts` | The mini-format renderer — the security-critical piece. | | `src/feed.ts` | Builds `
`; search matching. | | `src/hash.ts` | `#q=…¬e=…` parse/serialize/sync. | | `src/storage.ts` | localStorage + fixtures seeding, id sequence. | | `src/avatar.ts` | Avatar URL scheme allow-list. | | `src/main.ts` | State and wiring. | **The rich-text renderer never produces an HTML string.** It walks the source and builds nodes with `createElement` (always a *literal* tag name, via a `switch`) plus `createTextNode`. Anything outside `
` isn't markup here — it's text. So `` in a body renders as those literal characters, and there is no sink for a payload to reach at all. Links go through `setAnchorHref` from `safevalues/dom`, which is what neutralises `javascript:` (including entity-encoded forms, since I decode entities *before* handing the URL over). DOMPurify at the Trusted Types boundary is never reached — it stays a backstop rather than the defence. ## Judgment calls worth flagging - **Search matches both the raw source and the rendered text.** `Café Santiago` matches even though the stored source has a `` in the middle of it, and a search for a literal `` still works. Matching only one of the two would miss one of those cases. - **Titles render rich text too** ("Titles and bodies show the user's formatting"), but with anchors suppressed — the title sits inside the select button, and an `` inside a `
